verses.text: A psalm for reflection by David, when he was in the cave. A prayer. I cry out loud to the LORD. I lift my voice and beg him for mercy.
I pour out my complaint in front of him. I tell him exactly what’s hurting me.
When my spirit felt crushed, you knew the way I was taking. On the path I walk, they’ve hidden a trap for me.
Look to my right and see. Nobody’s looking out for me. I have nowhere to run, and nobody cares whether I live.
I cried out to you, LORD. I said, “You’re my refuge, my share in the land of the living.”
Listen to my cry, because I’m desperate. Save me from the people chasing me. They’re too strong for me.
Get me out of this prison so I can thank you for your name. The righteous will gather around me because you’ll be good to me.
